chunks: A number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Khalid, from Ali ibn Asbaat, raising it (to the Prophet), said:
Rasool-Allah (peace be upon him and his family) forbade bargaining during the time between the emergence of the dawn and the emergence of the sun.
ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on trading or bargaining between dawn and sunrise in Shia Islam?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi establishes a specific prohibition against bargaining (as-sawm) during the interval between the Fajr call to prayer and sunrise, a time traditionally associated with spiritual reflection and the preparation for daily duties. In Shia jurisprudence, this ruling underscores the integration of commercial ethics with devotional discipline, ensuring that worldly transactions do not distract from the sanctity of the early morning worship period. It highlights the Prophetic emphasis on maintaining a balance between economic activity and spiritual mindfulness.
